programme.title: Bachelor's Programme in Computer Science (Kandidatprogram i datavetenskap), 180 credits, application code UU-P1100
programme.how_found: Web search for the programme on uu.se gave the English programme page. The Swedish page was found through its hreflang=sv alternate link. No English-taught computer-science bachelor exists at Uppsala: the Faculty of Science and Technology page says most bachelor's programmes are taught only in Swedish and names the English-taught ones, none of them computer science. This Swedish-taught programme is therefore the closest official equivalent.

value.swedish_description: Programme requires knowledge of Swedish (Swedish 3 level as part of general entry requirements for Swedish-taught programmes; can be shown e.g. by TISUS)

english.quote: IELTS Academic: an overall score of 6.5 and no section below 5.5 TOEFL iBT: score of 20 (scale 0-30) in written test, total score of 90 Cambridge English: CAE or CPE
english.how_found: Programme page -> 'Bachelor's studies' -> Entry requirements (uu.se/en/study/bachelors-studies/application/entry-requirements). Swedish requirement taken from the programme page and the Swedish page on foreign education.
english.notes: These scores are the university-wide English 6 equivalents for bachelor's programmes. The programme also requires Swedish. The English programme page says: 'Note! This programme requires knowledge of Swedish. For information about the programme, see the Swedish page.' The uu.se page on foreign education (https://www.uu.se/utbildning/anmalan-och-antagning/utlandsk-utbildning) says: 'De flesta utbildningar vid Uppsala universitet kräver kunskaper i svenska och engelska. För de kurser och program som ges på engelska krävs inte kunskaper i svenska.' It also names Tisus as the test that shows Swedish proficiency. No uu.se page that was read gives an exact Swedish 3 grade or score for this programme, so the Swedish level is described here, not quantified.

value.description: No published minimum grade or average. Eligible applicants are ranked by final school grades (66% of places) and the Swedish Scholastic Aptitude Test, högskoleprovet (34% of places). Eligibility requires the general entry requirements plus Mathematics Further level 2, or Mathematics 4/Mathematics D.

gpa.quote: Selection Final school grades (66%) - Swedish Scholastic Aptitude Test (34%)
gpa.how_found: Programme page, Autumn 2027 accordion (Entry requirements / Selection).
gpa.notes: Admission model: when there are more eligible applicants than places, they are ranked by grades (66% of places) or by the högskoleprov (34%). No minimum is published. The Autumn 2027 entry requirement, quoted verbatim, is: 'General entry requirements and Mathematics Further level 2, or Mathematics 4/Mathematics D'. The högskoleprov is a Swedish-language test. Swedish pages: 'Urval Betyg (66 %) - Högskoleprov (34 %)'.

deadline.quote: Application deadline 15 April 2027 Application code UU-P1100
deadline.notes: The 2027 cycle is published: 'Autumn 2027' accordion, study period 30 August 2027–9 June 2030. 15 April is the Swedish national-round deadline. The programme's 'Apply now' link goes to antagning.se (period HT_2027, id UU-P1100), not to universityadmissions.se. The general bachelor's entry-requirements page tells international applicants to apply via universityadmissions.se. No earlier international-round deadline is listed for this Swedish-taught programme.

tuition.quote: First tuition fee instalment: SEK 75,000 Total tuition fee: SEK 450,000
tuition.notes: The fee is quoted from the Autumn 2027 accordion; Autumn 2026 shows identical figures. The page states: 'If you are not a citizen of a European Union (EU) or European Economic Area (EEA) country, or Switzerland, you are required to pay application and tuition fees.' The per-year figure of SEK 150,000 is derived as 450,000 / 3 years and is not stated on the page. Per-semester instalments of SEK 75,000 are inferred from the first instalment. The application fee is paid separately to University Admissions.

value.name: Anders Wall's Scholarship for Studies at Uppsala University

scholarship_exists.quote: This scholarship covers the full tuition fee for an international Bachelor’s or Master’s programme at Uppsala University. Please note that it does not cover living expenses.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Bachelor's studies -> Scholarships -> Uppsala University's scholarships.
scholarship_exists.notes: This is the only bachelor's scholarship listed. It is open only to 'Citizens of a country in Africa.', so a Kazakhstan citizen is NOT eligible. It also covers only 'international' Bachelor's programmes, and the application guide requires an international Bachelor's programme ranked first at universityadmissions.se. The Swedish-taught UU-P1100 is therefore very unlikely to qualify. Page note: 'The next scholarship round will open in early 2027 for students applying to Uppsala University.' The 2026 round ran 16 January–2 February 2026.

scholarship_international.quote: Uppsala University has a very limited number of scholarships that will cover tuition fees for international students admitted to our Bachelor’s programmes, and only students from a select number of countries can apply.
scholarship_international.notes: The scholarship is aimed at international, fee-paying students, but only citizens of selected countries can apply. Currently that means Africa only (Anders Wall), which excludes this applicant.

access_notes: All uu.se pages were fetched as static HTML with curl (HTTP 200) and text was extracted locally. No blocks, logins or JavaScript-only content.
The programme's 'Apply now' links point to antagning.se (Swedish national admissions), not to universityadmissions.se. antagning.se was not opened.
universityadmissions.se is linked from the uu.se entry-requirements and fees pages but was not opened. All values come from uu.se.
The English programme page has no programme description; it defers to the Swedish page.
